title: Tasks | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Tasks
hero.lead: Tasks can be personal, shared, recurring or generated for every match. The overview separates your assignments, tasks you created and all visible tasks.

body:
The three views

  • My tasks: tasks with at least one assignment for you.
  • Created by me: tasks you created. Kaderblick switches here after creation.
  • All: every task your account may access.

The three figures count your open and completed assignments and all loaded tasks. Open tasks precede completed ones; within each group, the next open due date determines order.

Create a task

  1. Open Tasks and select New task.
  2. Enter a short, clear title.
  3. Set the start date from which occurrences are generated.
  4. Choose a personal task or distribution to other users.
  5. Enable Recurring for regular or match-related occurrences.
  6. Add a description if required and select Save.

Personal task

Enable Personal task (only for me) if only you should receive it. You can then set your own reminder time. Accounts without permission for shared tasks always use this mode.

User rotation

For a shared task, choose the people considered in sequence under User rotation. People per task at the same time sets how many receive the same occurrence. The person picker also shows club or team context.

Recurring tasks

After enabling Recurring, choose:

  • Regular: daily, weekly or monthly. An interval can create, for example, a task every two weeks. Weekly rules require a weekday and monthly rules a day of the month.
  • Per match: creates occurrences for matches. The offset determines how many days before or after the match they are due.

Read and use a task card

A card shows title, description, creator, recurrence, next open date and assignment progress. Your occurrences appear under My assignments; other assigned people follow with date and status. More than five further assignments are summarised as a count.

  • Open: select the empty circle to complete your occurrence.
  • Completed: select the green tick to reopen it.
  • Declined: the assignment was declined and is labelled accordingly.
  • Substitute: a recorded substitute appears directly beside the assignment.

Edit and delete

Only the creator receives edit and delete actions. A one-off task requires confirmation. For a recurring task, choose This occurrence only or Entire series. The first removes the next open occurrence; if none remains, the task is deleted completely.

Visibility by role and relationship

  • Assigned person: sees own occurrences and switches them between open and completed.
  • Creator: also sees all assignments, total progress, edit and delete.
  • Account without shared-task permission: creates personal tasks with a reminder but no user rotation.
